subject: Sablefish
topic: NOAA's robot drove straight into a huge school of sablefish off Alaska.
script:
NOAA's robot drove straight into a huge school of sablefish off Alaska.
And the fish didn't seem to care at all.
Sablefish are also known as black cod.
They live in deep, cold waters across the North Pacific.
And they can live for a remarkably long time, more than ninety years.
Below them, the seafloor was covered wall to wall by corals and sponges.
Habitats like this give young fish shelter and food.
This was filmed in twenty twenty-three, during NOAA's Seascape Alaska expedition.
Would you have guessed a fish could live ninety years?
pkg_title: This Fish Can Live Over 90 YEARS 🐟 #Shorts
